description: This file defines the Affiliate class within the Opencart admin mail controllers. It handles email notifications for affiliate approval and denial processes, configuring email content and queuing tasks for email sending.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for handling email notifications related to affiliate approval and denial, including preparing email content and queuing email tasks.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles the process of notifying an affiliate of their approval via email, by loading necessary models, constructing email content, and queuing the email task.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles the process of notifying an affiliate of their denial via email, by loading necessary models, constructing email content, and queuing the email task.
